objective: Agentgres-owned atomic recognized-effect transaction for single_authority_v1: the crash-edge, publication-order and proof-substitution populations are release-accountable through one fail-empty wrapper, and the unit now has acceptance text.
falsifiable_claim: npm run check:recognized-effect-publication-order pins the 28 recognized_effect::tests names and the 10 ioi-finality proof-substitution names by exact name, pins from source the 21 declared phases (42 before/after crash edges) and the seven crash-edge iteration sites, and pins the predecessor-fencing (ACK cannot leapfrog) and ACK-last (uncommitted effect cannot publish/project/ACK) test names.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: npm run mutate:recognized-effect-publication-order plants (a) an absent test name, refused by the source binding; (b) a name whose fn exists but whose module path the harness cannot list, refused at --list; (c) an empty population, refused outright — the wrapper proves it can fail on its own finding before it is trusted green.
remaining_nonclaims: The wrapper proves the pinned tests execute and pass; it does not widen what those tests assert. The unit's acceptance clauses are proven only to the extent the pinned tests prove them.
A CI floor is not yet pinned for these root-workspace wrappers; verifier-floors.v1.json covers hypervisor-app journey verifiers only.
